door.signIn.heading: Sign in
door.signIn.eitherAccount: Your house’s Johns are kept with the account you sign in with.
door.signIn.sameAccount: Already in a house? Use the account you joined with.
door.signIn.terms: By continuing you agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy, and to the rules of the house you join, and say you’re 13 or older.
door.signIn.failed: {provider} didn’t finish signing you in. Try again.
door.signIn.returnFailed: That sign-in didn’t finish. Try again.
door.newHouse.heading: Start your house
door.newHouse.intro: You’ll be its admin. Next you add the Johns and send the house an invite.
door.newHouse.name: What do you call the house?
door.join.badLinkBody: It may be mistyped, or everyone has left that house. Ask whoever sent it for the link on their House screen, or start your own.
door.join.otherHouseBody: Jonz keeps you in one house at a time. Leave your current one from its House screen first.
door.join.livesHere: {people} {people, plural, =1 {person lives} other {people live}} here. Join and you’re dealt Johns from next week.
door.join.stake: This house plays for money: {stake} a month each, {late} for a late John and {missed} for a missed one, split between everyone else.
door.join.noStake: This house doesn’t play for money: it keeps score in points.
door.join.nextSignIn: Next you sign in or make an account. Nothing is joined until you say so.
door.noHouse.heading: No house yet
door.invite.newCodeNote: The old link and code stop working. Removing someone changes the code too.
door.welcome.startReason: Sign in to start your house.
door.welcome.inviteReason: Sign in to use your invite.
door.welcome.name: Name your house
door.welcome.changeSpoken: The currency and the day weeks start
door.welcome.zoneNote: The time zone is this phone’s, {zone}. Change it later from House.
door.welcome.welcome: Paste the invite someone sent you, or start a house of your own.
door.welcome.paste: Paste your invite link or code
door.welcome.pasteHint: The whole link, or just the eight letters and numbers at its end.
door.welcome.badInvite: That isn’t an invite link or code. Check it against the one you were sent.
door.welcome.points.list: List your house’s chores. We call them Johns.
door.welcome.points.share: Each week Jonz deals them out fairly.
door.welcome.points.stake: Everyone puts in the same each month. Miss a John and part of your stake goes to the ones who did theirs.
door.email.name: Your name
door.email.nameHint: What people at home call you, like Sam or Sam Lee. You can change it later.
door.email.noName: Add your name, so everyone at home knows it’s you.
door.email.agree: I agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy
door.email.notChecked: Still checking you’re not a bot. Try again in a moment.
door.email.noAgree: Tick the box to agree to the Terms and say you’re 13 or older.
door.email.codeHint: We sent a {length}-digit code to {email}. It may take a minute, and can land in spam.
door.email.toSignUp: New to Jonz? Make an account
door.email.resent: A new code is on its way.
door.email.forgotBody: We’ll email you a code. Type it in here, then choose a new password.
door.email.resetBody: We sent a {length}-digit code to {email}, if it has an account.
door.email.existingHint: Already have an account with this email? Sign in, or reset your password.
door.email.badEmail: That doesn’t look like an email address.
door.email.badCode: Type the {length}-digit code from the email.
door.email.wrongPassword: That email and password don’t match. Try again, or reset your password.
door.email.unconfirmed: That account isn’t confirmed yet. We’ve sent a new code.
door.email.wrongCode: That code is wrong or has run out. Check the newest email, or send a new code.
door.email.weakPassword: Pick a harder password. That one is too easy to guess.
door.email.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
door.email.notOpen: Email sign-in isn’t open yet. Use Google or Microsoft for now.
door.email.needsAuthenticator: This account has an authenticator app, so the password wasn’t saved. Sign in with Google or Microsoft, then add a password on your House page under You.
door.password.label: Password
door.password.addBody: Then you can also sign in with {email} and a password.
door.password.changeBody: You sign in with {email} and this password.
door.password.authenticatorBody: Your account has an authenticator app. Type its code to save the password.
door.password.wrongAuthenticator: That code didn’t work. Type the newest one from your authenticator app.
